verdict: GO — bounded simultaneous three-allocation APID selection

observations.resource: P-CREW capacity 2 at one-spare POINTs and 3 at two-spare POINTs; all three preparations lease two crew for 10 minutes, then release them, and finish at 7.5/19.5/31.5. ResourceResults.NR is 2/3 in all 72 bins; NRUM is 2/3 only in bins 14/38/62; NRW is zero.
observations.inventory: Native BASE stock item identities show 1->0->1 and 2->1->2 after first issue/repair; DEPOT arms issue a second spare at 34 and end at BASE stock 0/1. Aggregate StockTotalResults does not expose on-hand counts.
observations.maintenance: First failed item repairs at BASE 10.1667-11.1667 or DEPOT 12.1667-13.1667 after 2-hour outward transport, then returns BASE at 15.1667. In DEPOT arms, a distinct second item fails at 33.9619 and begins outward transit 34.1667; no second repair completion or stock return is logged by 36.
observations.missions: All first missions abort and all second missions succeed; third mission succeeds only in BASE arms and aborts at 33.9619 in DEPOT arms. Aircraft is ready at horizon in all arms.
observations.backorder: Native DEPOT log adds an internal backorder after each failed-item dispatch; the second remains unresolved at hour 36 although every aggregate StockTotalResults.NBO bin is zero.

scope: One LRU, four APID POINTs jointly selecting P-CREW capacity 2/3, BASE spare size 1/2, and BASE/DEPOT repair; one seed.
limits: P-CREW 2/3 is correlated with stock 1/2; separate resource-versus-stock causation is not identified.
DEPOT arms have a second failure at 33.9619 and its failed item remains in transit at horizon; no terminal depot replenishment or matched mission outcomes across routes is claimed.
Aggregate StockTotalResults.NBO is zero despite physical depot backorder events; it cannot prove absence of internal backorders or on-hand stock quantity.
No shortage, procurement/reorder, other seeds, category/level changes, GUI visual behavior, or cross-engine parity is tested.
